goal: Make deterministic QA always run a project-declared baseline read from the Enrollment base tree, and disclose rather than block a baseline check that fails identically at base_head.

acceptance.assertion: Meet S3 in docs/specs/review-convergence.spec.md: QA reads docs/agents/qa-baseline.json from the base_head tree, never the delivery; a failing baseline check yields a blocking QA finding with acceptance_id null; when the same check also fails on the materialized base_head tree the finding is advisory with the pre-existing baseline failure prefix and is disclosed; a failing acceptance descriptor never receives this tolerance; an absent baseline file adds no checks; this repository declares bun run typecheck as its baseline.
